name: Vuori
desc: California performance apparel brand selling men's and women's activewear through its own stores, e-commerce and retailers such as Nordstrom and REI.
customers: consumers; wholesale via Nordstrom, REI, Equinox
minority_investors: SoftBank Vision Fund 2; Norwest Venture Partners; General Atlantic; Stripes
marketing_autonomy_basis: independent company; founder-CEO Joe Kudla retains majority ownership (Wikipedia)
markets: United States core; e-commerce and wholesale in UK, France, Germany, Ireland, Netherlands, Australia, Canada; London store
expansion_markets: store roll-out (headline cited on Wikipedia: about 25 new stores a year)

fin.value_orig: USD 825m secondary tender led by General Atlantic and Stripes

signals.what: USD 825m tender led by General Atlantic and Stripes at about USD 5.5bn valuation

fit_rationale: Fast-growing USD 5bn+ activewear brand expanding from the US into the UK, Europe and Australia; F1's US races and young US audience suit a premium lifestyle brand building international awareness.
category_conflict: potential: Puma, Tommy Hilfiger and other team apparel partners
f1_markets: United States (Miami, Austin, Las Vegas), UK, Canada, Australia, Netherlands
outstanding: revenue; current store count; marketing head

name: Dickies
desc: American workwear brand founded in Fort Worth in 1922, selling work trousers, shirts and streetwear in more than 100 countries.
products: work trousers, shirts, overalls, workwear, streetwear
marketing_autonomy_basis: brand owned by brand-management firm Bluestar Alliance since Nov 2025
markets: brand sold in more than 100 countries incl. US, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Germany, France, Italy, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, South Africa

fin.value_orig: approx. USD 600m cash (Bluestar Alliance acquisition from VF Corporation)

alt_indicators.evidence: brand found in more than 100 countries
acquired by Bluestar Alliance for about USD 600m in cash (completed 12 Nov 2025); VF paid USD 820m in 2017

sponsorships.rights_holder: Ariat Arena, Fort Worth (formerly Dickies Arena naming rights)

signals.what: Bluestar Alliance completed acquisition of Dickies from VF Corporation
HQ relocation from Fort Worth to California announced

fit_rationale: Workwear heritage brand with trade and pit-crew credibility, sold in 100+ countries; new owner Bluestar is repositioning it after the VF sale, and F1 merchandise or garage-crew kit fits its utility image.
f1_markets: United States, Mexico, Japan, Australia, Saudi Arabia, Italy

access.roles: Brand President; CMO at Bluestar Alliance

outstanding: revenue under new owner; marketing head

name: Hot Topic
desc: US specialty retailer of licensed pop-culture, music and fandom apparel and merchandise, operating Hot Topic and BoxLunch stores.
products: licensed band and pop-culture T-shirts, accessories, collectibles
parent_immediate: Sycamore Partners (sale to Spencer Spirit Holdings announced Aug 2026)
marketing_autonomy_basis: to operate as an independent subsidiary under Spencer Spirit Holdings (Wikipedia)

alt_indicators.evidence: sponsored Ozzfest (2004), Sounds of the Underground (2005-2007), Taste of Chaos and Mayhem Festival (2008-2009)

sponsorships.rights_holder: Ozzfest; Mayhem Festival; Taste of Chaos

signals.what: Spencer Spirit Holdings announced acquisition of Hot Topic from Sycamore Partners

fit_rationale: Licensed-merchandise retailer with hundreds of US mall stores; F1's growing US fandom and licensed merchandise could feed its pop-culture product lines rather than hospitality.

access.roles: CEO; Chief Merchandising Officer; licensing head

outstanding: current store count and revenue; deal closing

name: Colin's
desc: Turkish denim and casual fashion brand of Eroğlu Holding, with over 600 stores in 24 countries and its own jeans production.
stores_or_sites: 600+ stores (2024); production capacity about 20m units a year
markets: Turkey, Russia and neighbouring markets; 24 countries

signals.what: Eroğlu announced USD 40m jeans factory in Egypt's SCZone, 2,750 planned jobs

fit_rationale: Vertically integrated Turkish denim chain with 600+ stores across 24 countries; F1 visibility in Turkey-adjacent, Middle East and European markets would support its mass-market brand.
f1_markets: Turkey (no current race), Azerbaijan, Saudi Arabia

access.roles: Eroğlu Holding board; Colin's Marketing Director

compliance: large Russian market exposure historically (Wikipedia); not a Russian company
outstanding: Wikipedia page flagged as promotional; verify figures; Russia exposure: check compliance (company is Turkish, not Russian)

name: Le Coq Sportif
desc: French sportswear brand founded in Romilly-sur-Seine, kit supplier to football clubs and former outfitter of the French Olympic team.
products: sportswear, football and rugby kit, sneakers
parent_immediate: Airesis SA (historic majority owner); Dan Mamane's takeover plan approved July 2025
markets: France, Italy, South Korea, Argentina, Brazil, Lebanon, South Africa

fin.value_orig: EUR 70m contribution in Dan Mamane's recovery offer

exception_note: Revenue EUR 109m (Route B band) supported by significant sports sponsorship: Paris 2024 French Olympic team outfitter, Tour de France leader jerseys 2012-2021, FFR rugby 2018-2024, clubs such as Atlético Mineiro and Rosario Central.
distress: receivership (redressement judiciaire) from 22 Nov 2024; takeover by Dan Mamane approved July 2025 with 89-94 job cuts

signals.what: Dan Mamane's takeover offer with EUR 70m contribution approved by court

fit_rationale: Heritage French sportswear brand relaunching under a new owner after receivership; a team-wear or capsule licensing deal could restore premium relevance, but finances are weak.
f1_markets: France (no race), Italy, Brazil, Argentina (no race)
outstanding: current owner structure after 2025 takeover; whether Airesis still holds shares

name: Speedo
desc: Swimwear and swim-equipment brand founded in Sydney in 1914, now based in Nottingham and owned by the private Pentland Group.
products: swimwear, racing suits, goggles, swim equipment
marketing_autonomy_basis: own CEO (Chirag Patel) and global brand organisation
markets: global; Speedo International, Speedo Australia and Speedo USA (rights bought back from PVH 2020)

fin.value_orig: USD 170m (Speedo USA rights bought from PVH, 2020)

alt_indicators.evidence: sponsors national swimming federations (Canada, Japan, Mexico, Finland) and about 45 elite swimmers incl. Adam Peaty, Ariarne Titmus, Caeleb Dressel
operations in UK, Australia and USA; distribution reached 112 countries (older figure)

sponsorships.rights_holder: Swimming Canada; Japan Swimming Federation; Mexican Swimming Federation

fit_rationale: Global performance brand that markets through elite athletes and federations; F1's technology and performance story mirrors its LZR racing-suit positioning, though Pentland's sister brands need consideration.
category_conflict: none found; parent Pentland Group is on the master
f1_markets: UK, Australia, United States, Japan, Mexico, Canada
outstanding: revenue; recent news (Wikipedia shows none after 2020)
